description: Switch Windows virtual desktops with a mouse gesture. No Administrator privileges, no runtime, no driver.
notes: Start it once from the Start menu, or run: mouse-desktop
Scoop does NOT register it to start with Windows. The installer script in the
repository does, and this does not, so tick it yourself: right click the tray icon
(two blue arrows, next to the clock) and choose 'Start with Windows'.
Configuration lives in %APPDATA%\mouse-desktop\config.toml and survives updates.
Do not put a config.toml next to the executable: Scoop replaces that folder on every
update and it would be lost.
The executable is not signed. On a managed laptop Windows may refuse to run it. See
https://mouse-desktop.nivelepsilon.com for how to check, and for the request your IT
